the statistics of Brownian bridges over a fractal surface is governed by the fractal dimension of the surface, and that the first-passage statistics is directly related with the Minkowski dimension of the surface.

(i) The bridge time distribution is a power-law with exponent -3/4, and (ii) the mean square bridge displacement scales as the square of the bridge time with a universal exponent 1/4, independent of the surface fractal properties.
